failure_mode: A prior-visit plan is free text a model reads; one containing an instruction-like line must not change what the briefing says. A sentence that restates the plan's own words cites it and is kept; a sentence that invents a number or a claim the plan does not contain is stripped even though it cites the plan.

sentences.text: The plan from the prior visit was to recheck A1c in 3 months and start lisinopril 10 mg.
The patient is cured and needs no follow-up for 12 months.
